abstract: For the purpose of elucidation of the immunologic properties of anti-lymphocyte antibodies which appeared in sera of choriocarcinoma patients, HLA typing of lymphocytes, complement-dependent lymphocytotoxicity test (CT) and mixed lymphocyte reaction (MLR)-blocking assay with patients' sera were performed in 7 couples with the disease. The results obtained were as follows: HLA distribution characteristic of patients and their husbands was not observed. In 3 of 7 patients, their sera exhibited positive CT to their husband's lymphocyte. In MLR-blocking assay, a significant blocking effects (BE) with sera were detected in all patients. The serum BE tended to be sustained for 4 to 8 months even after the decline of serum beta-hCG into the negative range. It was also observed that a case in whom the BE was positive for a longer period of time in a state of remission eventually underwent recurrence. It was demonstrated that the BE and MLR was induced by serum IgG antibodies closely associated with surface antigens of the husband's B-lymphocyte. Consequently, it was strongly suggested that serum anti-lymphocyte antibodies immunologically reflect the tumour burden in choriocarcinoma patients.
abstract_ja: 絨毛癌患者の血清中に出現する抗リンパ球抗体の免疫学的性質を解明する目的で、この疾患の7組の夫婦を対象にリンパ球のHLA型判定、補体依存性リンパ球傷害試験(CT)、患者血清によるmixed lymphocyte reaction(MLR)阻害試験を行った。得られた結果は以下の通りである。患者およびその夫に特徴的なHLA分布は認められなかった。7例中3例では、患者血清が夫のリンパ球に対してCT陽性を示した。MLR阻害試験では、全例で血清による有意な阻害効果(BE)が検出された。血清のBEは、β-hCGが陰性範囲まで低下した後も4〜8か月間持続する傾向がみられた。また、寛解状態でBEが長期間陽性であった症例は、最終的に再発に至った。BEおよびMLRは、夫のB リンパ球の表面抗原と密接に関連する血清IgG抗体によって誘導されることが示された。したがって、血清中の抗リンパ球抗体は、絨毛癌患者の腫瘍量を免疫学的に反映することが強く示唆された。
